reviews.title: Something my 9800x3d will feel great in
reviews.comment: So far, it’s what I feel is needed. I already have the B850–I by Asus and it’s a great motherboard. But the m.2 is at the rear and it just doesn’t get any circulation. Leading to higher temps. I mostly got this for the memory I’m using. DDR5 6600 works alright, but I want to see how well the X870 platform works. Other than that I’m happy with my purchase. Looking forward to using the HIVE system. I now have an all AMD, almost all Asus build with a 9800x3D, this motherboard, a nitro+ 9070xt, 96gb’s of Corsair DDR5 6600, Samsung 980 and 990 for drives and a 1200 watt SFX Asus Loki PSU. Don’t be discouraged by the recent memory prices as you can get cases, monitors and PSU’s for decent prices still. Plan your build right and don’t be fooled by manufacturers word salad.
reviews.author: Dirk Jewitt

reviews.title: Stable, unlike another x870 board of this form factor
reviews.comment: I tried a different x870 board and had stability issues (freeze on windows startup). This one worked first try with no issues. Tradeoff is no 5gbps NIC with this board, but it’s perfectly stable.
